name: Corona-Arc Cliff
core_rationale: Northernmost lightning-glass escarpment of Thunder-Coil Basin at [1, 0] where Krono's index-finger spire discharges cyan corona ribbons into the upper clouds.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Storm-spotters say the fulgurite glass trees along Corona-Arc Cliff ring like crystal bells whenever a cloud-ship passes overhead.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A sheer copper cliff crowned by a hundred-meter brass finger-spire wreathed in violet-blue St. Elmo's fire.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Does Krono's index-finger spire on Corona-Arc Cliff point toward a hidden sky-dock in the clouds?

causal_continuity.evidence: Marks the easternmost termination of scar-brass-faultline in Thunder-Coil Basin.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Fulgurite lightning-glass groves surrounding a colossal brass finger-spire glowing with St. Elmo's fire.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: terrain tile and prop kit metrics for 1.05m characters will be bound when promoted to Canon.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: gated behind the North fog_of_lore portal on town-inductor-switchyard.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Maintains map_id: null and complete mystery_hook without generating filler map geometry.
